summary: Optional contract for reacting to knockback, since how you get pushed depends on what you are.
purpose: Pushing a Rigidbody, nudging a CharacterController and staggering a scripted boss are three different things. Rather than guess, a Hurtbox hands the knockback to this if the target has one, and skips it otherwise.
whenToImplement: When something should physically react to being hit. A static prop or a target that only tracks damage needs no implementation at all.

ApplyKnockback(Vector3).contract: React to a push in the given world direction and magnitude, however suits this object.
ApplyKnockback(Vector3).mustNot: Do not assume a physics body. The whole reason this is an interface is that the right response differs per target.

calledBy: Hurtbox, once per hit, and ONLY if the target implements it. Nothing else calls it.
useCases: Pushing a Rigidbody enemy away from an impact.
Nudging a CharacterController, which ignores forces entirely.
A boss that staggers rather than moving.

gotchas.title: Entirely optional
gotchas.body: No implementation means no knockback, silently. That is the intended behaviour, not a missing wire.
